findings.title: Orders: scenario sizing
findings.message: At 3× traffic in “Black Friday”, HPA hits its maximum of 10 at 92% CPU of request (target 70% CPU of request). Up to 4,006 messages waited while replicas started. Raise the maximum to 14. A rerun with this change confirmed it.

fix.label: Raise maximum to 14
fix.needsChoice: Its edit ops are too long for this reply: make the change with edit_diagram.

findings.title: Every request goes through one Orders
findings.message: It runs 1 replica, and every request from Traffic goes through it: if it stops, Traffic gets nothing.

output.hint: To fix one, send its fix.ops to edit_diagram as they are (one undo step). Only the person can ignore a finding.
